Class FakeShell

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.testing.FakeShell
All Implemented Interfaces:
SystemShell
public final class FakeShell extends Object implements SystemShell
The tester's SystemShell: it supports both actions, and records the URIs browsed and the files opened. A test of a system that can't browse turns browsing off.
